summary.zh: 定义指标、搭看板，做留存与队列分析
summary.en: Define KPIs, build dashboards and run retention analysis

description.zh: 定义产品关键指标，搭建指标看板，做队列与留存分析，并解读功能采用趋势。适合在确定北极星指标、解释留存下滑，或评估新功能表现时使用。
description.en: Defines product KPIs, builds metric dashboards and runs cohort, retention and feature adoption analysis. Use it to set a north-star metric, explain a retention drop or judge how a new feature is landing.
